author: @mr.mayhem1975
text: I WISH I could believe that the benefits of this tech would be shared with people who AREN'T in the 7-figure club... but given human nature, I just can't. History has proven this more times than you can count, and I personally know humanity far too well and have seen too much in my 50 years of life to believe in techno-utopianism. The FIRST thing humanity does once they get new tech- even something that most people say is harmless is "how do we use this to consolidate our power and kill LOTS of people?" Humans have proven- over and over- that they can't handle power at any level. Until we evolve past the greed our genetic heritage has handed us, optimistic futures like this channel presents will sadly remain fiction.

author: @SuperMortalix
text: This resembles peoples scepticism towards utopia because the classical meaning of utopia means everyone is satisfied and happy. But what if utopia is relative. For instance if you live in a house with heating clean water furniture electricity and internet.. how much better do you live compared to 1500th century kings and queens. Its relative right? compared to them we live in a utopia. We dont complain if we have this, because we are born into it. Just as the kings and queens didnt complain about their living either, they were born into it.. and to them it was the best possible way of living.. The video is a relative utopia we havent been born into.. so we resist.. its natural.. But if its true, we see it with our own eyes and it becomes the new norm, the new relative utopia.

author: @joshchisholm50
text:
I’m sorry buddy, but this is utter BS.
You might be a good hearted dreamer, hoping for a smooth transition in order to soothe your anxiety, but it’s much more likely you’re earning a small paycheck from big tech to spread propaganda.
Do you really believe that the people who hold all the power and money and land are going to give you a fantastic life out of the goodness of their hearts?!
My man, you need to grow up and look around.
Human beings are jealous, selfish, greedy creatures and money corrupts everything and everyone.
The only shot we have for the future is that population collapse will force them to employ us to do things machines simply aren’t suited for, but I even doubt that. 
Do you think the super rich want to share anything with the masses. 
Imagine a world where maybe 100,000 people share this planet which is run by robots and AI
No herds of beggars who contribute nothing but mouths to feed.
Read The Grapes of Wrath—Steinbeck, and stop playing around with your soothing fantasy or your disgusting shill job for the oligarchs
